description: This file contains JavaScript code for geolocation functionalities, including user location retrieval via IP and browser, geocoding, Google Maps integration, and autocomplete features, with licensing and license notices included.

methods.name: getUserLocation
methods.description: Retrieves the user's location, either from cache or by geolocation via IP.

methods.name: saveGeolocationData
methods.description: Sends geolocation data to the server via POST request.

methods.name: setLocationFromGeoip
methods.description: Fetches geolocation data based on IP address from the server.

methods.name: getLocationFromBrowser
methods.description: Attempts to get user's location using browser's geolocation API and reverse geocodes to get address details.

methods.name: setLocationFromBrowser
methods.description: Wrapper to get location from browser and save it.

methods.name: geoCode
methods.description: Performs geocoding using Google Maps API to get location details from coordinates.

methods.name: setGoogleMapPoint
methods.description: Initializes a Google Map with markers, geocoding, and event handling.

methods.name: getGoogleAddressFromAutocomplete
methods.description: Extracts address components from a Google Places autocomplete result.

methods.name: changePlace
methods.description: Populates form fields and updates map based on selected place from autocomplete.

methods.name: setGoogleAutocomplete
methods.description: Sets up Google Places autocomplete on input fields.
